28 ticks per motor turn × 19.2 = 537.7 per output turn

The outside parts come from goBILDA's CAD for the 5203 motor. That file is the 1:1 version, so the barrel was lengthened by one stage (about 10 mm) to hold the two 19.2:1 stages. goBILDA's CAD has no gears, armature or encoder parts inside; those are modeled here. Sun and ring tooth counts follow goBILDA's ratio formula, (1 + 46/17) × (1 + 46/11). Planet tooth counts and colors are approximate.

Speeds and ticks per revolution are goBILDA's published specs for the 5203-2402-0019 (312 RPM) motor.
